parameters.help_en:
The list of backend servers to add. The list contains the following parameters:

ServerId: String, required. The instance ID of the backend server. The value can be the ID of an ECS instance, an ENI instance, or an ECI instance. If ServerId is set to the ID of an ENI or ECI instance, the Type parameter is required.

Weight: The weight of the backend server. Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 100.
If the value is set to 0, no requests are forwarded to the backend server.

Description: String, optional. The description of the backend server. The description must be 1 to 80 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), and underscores (_).

Type: The server type of the backend server. Valid values:

    - ecs: ECS instance (default).
    
    - eni: network interface controller (NIC) instance.

    - eci: Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instance.

Only guaranteed-performance instances support adding eni and eci types of backend servers.

ServerIp: The IP address of the ENI or ECI instance.

Examples:

Mount an ECS instance:
 
  `[{ "ServerId": "i-xxxxxxxxx", "Weight": "100", "Type": "ecs", "Description":"test-112" }]`

Mount an ENI:

  `[{ "ServerId": "eni-xxxxxxxxx", "Weight": "100", "Type": "eni", "ServerIp": "192.168.**.**", "Description":"test-112" }]`

Mount an ENI with multiple IP addresses:

   `[{ "ServerId": "eni-xxxxxxxxx", "Weight": "100", "Type": "eni", "ServerIp": "192.168.**.**", "Description":"test-113" },{ "ServerId": "eni-xxxxxxxxx", "Weight": "100", "Type": "eni", "ServerIp": "172.166.**.**", "Description":"test-113" }]`

Mount an ECI instance:

  `[{ "ServerId": "eci-xxxxxxxxx", "Weight": "100", "Type": "eci", "ServerIp": "192.168.**.**", "Description":"test-114" }]`

Only backend servers in the running state can be added to a Server Load Balancer instance. You can add up to 20 backend servers in each call
parameters.help_zh:
要添加的后端服务器列表，包含以下参数：

ServerId：String类型，必选，后端服务器的实例ID，分为ECS实例ID、ENI实例ID和ECI实例ID，当ServerId参数值为ENI实例ID或ECI实例ID时，Type参数值必选。

Weight：后端服务器的权重，取值：0~100。默认值：100。
如果值为0，则不会将请求转发给该后端服务器。

Description：String类型，非必选，后端服务器描述，长度为1~80个字符，支持中文、字母、数字、短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）和下划线（_）。

Type：后端服务器类型，取值：

    - ecs：ECS实例（默认）。
    
    - eni：弹性网卡实例。

    - eci：弹性容器实例。

只有性能保障型实例支持添加eni和eci类型的后端服务器。

ServerIp：ENI或ECI的实例IP。

示例说明如下：

挂载ECS示例：
 
  `[{ "ServerId": "i-xxxxxxxxx", "Weight": "100", "Type": "ecs", "Description":"test-112" }]`

挂载ENI：

  `[{ "ServerId": "eni-xxxxxxxxx", "Weight": "100", "Type": "eni", "ServerIp": "192.168.**.**", "Description":"test-112" }]`

挂载ENI多IP：

   `[{ "ServerId": "eni-xxxxxxxxx", "Weight": "100", "Type": "eni", "ServerIp": "192.168.**.**", "Description":"test-113" },{ "ServerId": "eni-xxxxxxxxx", "Weight": "100", "Type": "eni", "ServerIp": "172.166.**.**", "Description":"test-113" }]`

挂载ECI：

  `[{ "ServerId": "eci-xxxxxxxxx", "Weight": "100", "Type": "eci", "ServerIp": "192.168.**.**", "Description":"test-114" }]`

必须是状态为运行中的后端服务器才可以加入负载均衡实例，每次调用最多可添加20个后端服务器
